# PRIVACY POLICY

**Service Writer Platform**  
**Effective Date:** March 22, 2026  
**Last Updated:** March 22, 2026

## 1. INTRODUCTION

Welcome to Service Writer, an auto shop management platform designed to help automotive service businesses manage customers, appointments, inventory, and operations.

### Who We Are

Service Writer is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform operated by Service Writer, Inc. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

**Data Controller:** Service Writer, Inc.  
**Data Protection Officer (DPO):** privacy@servicewriter.xyz  
**Support Contact:** support@servicewriter.xyz  
**Website:** https://servicewriter.xyz

### Our Commitment to Privacy

We take your privacy seriously and are committed to:
- Transparency about what data we collect and why
- Giving you control over your personal information
- Protecting your data with industry-standard security measures
- Complying with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations
- Never selling your personal information to third parties

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use our platform.

## 6. DATA RETENTION

We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy and to comply with legal requirements.

### 6.1 Retention Periods

| Data Type | Retention Period | Justification |
|-----------|------------------|---------------|
| **Customer PII** | 7 years after last transaction | Tax requirements (IRS 3-year audit + 4-year extended) |
| **Appointments & Service Records** | 7 years after service date | Legal liability, warranty claims |
| **Payment Records** | 7 years after transaction | Tax/legal compliance, financial audits |
| **Work Orders & Invoices** | 7 years after completion | Tax compliance, accounting records |
| **HR Documents** | 7 years after employment ends | Employment law (EEOC, FLSA) |
| **GPS Location History** | 90 days | Fleet management operations only |
| **Job Photos** | 2 years after service | Warranty and dispute resolution |
| **Audit Logs** | 1 year (365 days) | Security monitoring, compliance |
| **SMS Logs** | 90 days | Operational debugging |
| **Email Logs** | 90 days | Delivery tracking |
| **Error Logs** | 90 days | Bug tracking |

### 6.2 Automated Cleanup

We have automated cleanup jobs that permanently delete expired data:
- **location-history-cleanup:** Deletes GPS data older than 90 days
- **job-photos-cleanup:** Deletes service photos older than 2 years
- **hr-document-expiry:** Deletes expired licenses and documents
- **audit-log-cleanup:** Deletes audit logs older than 1 year
- **sms-log-cleanup:** Deletes SMS logs older than 90 days

### 6.3 Account Deletion

When you delete your account:
- All your data is **soft-deleted immediately** (marked as deleted, not visible)
- Data is retained for **30 days** in soft-deleted state (for recovery if needed)
- After 30 days, data is **permanently deleted** from all systems and backups
- Auth credentials are deleted immediately (you cannot log in)

## 7. YOUR RIGHTS (GDPR & CCPA)

### 7.1 GDPR Rights (European Users)

If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the following rights under GDPR:

**Article 15 - Right to Access:**
- You can request a copy of all your personal data
- Use the **"Export My Data"** button in Settings
- Receive a JSON file with all your data

**Article 16 - Right to Rectification:**
- You can correct inaccurate or incomplete data
- Update your information directly in the app
- Contact support for assistance

**Article 17 - Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"):**
- You can request deletion of your personal data
- Use the **"Delete My Account"** button in Settings
- Requires typing "DELETE_MY_ACCOUNT" to confirm
- 30-day grace period before permanent deletion

**Article 18 - Right to Restriction:**
- You can restrict processing of your data
- Soft-delete feature marks data as deleted without permanent removal
- Contact support to request restriction

**Article 20 - Right to Data Portability:**
- You can receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
- JSON export includes all your data
- Can transfer to another service

**Article 21 - Right to Object:**
- You can object to processing for marketing purposes
- Opt out of analytics and non-essential processing
- Managed via consent settings

**Article 22 - Automated Decision-Making:**
- We do not use automated decision-making or profiling
- AI assistant is advisory only, not decision-making

### 7.2 CCPA Rights (California Users)

If you are a California resident, you have the following rights under CCPA:

**Right to Know:**
- Request disclosure of personal information collected
- See categories of data and sources
- Understand purposes for collection

**Right to Delete:**
- Request deletion of personal information
- Same process as GDPR Right to Erasure

**Right to Opt-Out:**
- Opt out of sale of personal information
- **Note:** We do not sell personal information

**Right to Non-Discrimination:**
- Equal service regardless of privacy choices
- No penalties for exercising your rights

## 8. HOW TO EXERCISE YOUR RIGHTS

### 8.1 Self-Service Tools (Recommended)

**Export Your Data:**
1. Log in to your account
2. Go to Settings > Privacy & Data
3. Click **"Export My Data"**
4. JSON file downloads automatically with all your data

**Delete Your Account:**
1. Log in to your account
2. Go to Settings > Privacy & Data
3. Click **"Delete My Account"**
4. Read warnings carefully
5. Type "DELETE_MY_ACCOUNT" to confirm
6. Your data is soft-deleted immediately
7. Permanent deletion after 30-day grace period

For other privacy requests or questions:

**Response Time:** Within 30 days  
**Subject Line:** "Privacy Request - [Your Request Type]"

**Required Information:**
- Your full name
- Email address associated with account
- Description of your request
- Proof of identity (for security)

## 9. COOKIES & TRACKING

### 9.1 Cookies We Use

**Essential Cookies (Required):**
- Session authentication tokens
- User preferences and settings
- CSRF protection tokens

**Analytics Cookies (Optional):**
- PostHog analytics (anonymized usage data)
- Helps us improve the platform
- Can be disabled in Settings

**Third-Party Cookies:**
- Stripe (payment processing)
- Google Calendar (if OAuth connected)
- QuickBooks (if OAuth connected)

### 9.2 Cookie Consent

We use a cookie consent banner on first visit. You can:
- Accept all cookies
- Reject optional cookies (analytics only)

Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are necessary for platform functionality.

### 9.3 Do Not Track

We respect Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals:

- No tracking across websites

## 11. SECURITY MEASURES

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:

### 11.1 Technical Security

**Encryption:**
- Data in transit: TLS 1.3 encryption
- Data at rest: AES-256 encryption
- OAuth tokens: AES-256-GCM encryption
- Passwords: bcrypt hashing (never stored in plaintext)

**Access Control:**
- Row-level security (RLS) policies in database
- Multi-tenant isolation (your data separated from others)
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Service role authentication for backend operations

**Network Security:**
- HTTPS only (no HTTP allowed)
- CORS policies to prevent cross-origin attacks
- CSRF protection tokens
- Rate limiting on APIs

### 11.2 Data Protection

**Soft Delete:**
- Deleted data marked as "deleted" not immediately removed
- Allows recovery from accidental deletion
- Soft-deleted data excluded from queries automatically
- Permanent deletion after retention period

**PII Sanitization:**
- Error logs sanitize email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses
- Sentry configured with sendDefaultPii: false
- Regex-based PII redaction in all logs
- No PII in analytics events

**Audit Logging:**
- All data access logged to audit_logs table
- Retention: 1 year
- Includes user ID, action, timestamp, entity
- Helps detect unauthorized access

### 11.3 Operational Security

**Employee Access:**
- Principle of least privilege
- Only authorized personnel access customer data
- Background checks for employees with data access
- Regular security training

**Third-Party Security:**
- All processors require DPAs
- Annual security reviews
- SOC 2 compliance verification
- Incident response procedures

**Incident Response:**
- Data breach notification within 72 hours (GDPR requirement)
- Email to all affected users
- DPO coordination with authorities
- Post-incident analysis and remediation

### 11.4 Vulnerability Management

**Security Practices:**
- Regular security audits
- Penetration testing (annual)
- Dependency vulnerability scanning
- CodeQL security analysis on all code

**Responsible Disclosure:**
- Security vulnerabilities: security@servicewriter.xyz
- Bug bounty program (coming soon)
- Recognition for responsible disclosure

## 14. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Service Writer is a business-to-business (B2B) platform intended for use by automotive service businesses. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age.

If we discover that we have inadvertently collected data from a child under 13, we will delete it immediately.

Parents or guardians who believe we have collected information from a child should contact us at privacy@servicewriter.xyz.
